title: Build the dropped-retirement-target reminder in the caller's spelling and cover it through MCP memories full
outcome: Build the dropped-retirement-target reminder in the caller's spelling and cover it through MCP memories full
acceptance: The reminder a full memories read gives for a dropped retirement target is built in the caller's spelling where the response is assembled, not rewritten afterwards by string equality

A test reads memories with full:true through the MCP words while a revision has dropped the retirement target, and asserts the reminder names retires_with and clear_retires_with; the CLI form keeps --retires-with and --clear-retires-with

completion.summary: Build dropped-retirement-target full-memory reminders with caller argument spelling at response assembly; preserve CLI flags and verify the MCP words through a real server.
